name: lanlens
description: Query a self-hosted LanLens inventory from Claude through the official read-only-by-default MCP companion.
long_description: The official LanLens MCP companion exposes safe inventory, device, service, port, topology, segment, notification, and network-change tools. Credentials, secrets, password locations, private notes, and raw authentication material are never returned. An allow-listed device metadata write tool can be enabled explicitly.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Get LanLens health and build metadata.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Search and filter the safe LanLens inventory.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Get one safe device inventory record.

tools.name: list_open_ports
tools.description: List recent port scans for a device.

tools.name: get_topology
tools.description: Get safe network topology nodes and relationships.

lanlens_url.title: LanLens URL
lanlens_url.description: Base URL of your LanLens instance, reachable from this computer.

api_token.title: LanLens API token
api_token.description: Persistent LanLens Bearer token. Use the default read-only token policy whenever possible.

enable_writes.title: Enable device metadata writes
enable_writes.description: Expose the allow-listed update tool. The LanLens token must separately permit writes.
